rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.quote: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.summary: Berkeley rental housing providers are prohibited from asking about or using criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decision-making.
rules.effective_date_evidence: On April 14, 2020, Berkeley City Council passed the Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (BMC 13.106).
rules.coverage_text: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence are exempt. Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates are exempt. Lifetime sex offenders and certain public housing/Section 8 properties have limited exemptions.
rules.exemption_note: Owner-occupied properties with 1-3 units where owner resides as primary residence; units with existing tenants seeking sublet/roommates; lifetime sex offenders; certain public housing/Section 8 properties
rules.penalty: Administrative fines of at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation, civil damages including actual damages or three times the amount of one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief.
